_comment: Unit-suite coverage ratchet (P1). SEMANTIC BOUNDARY: this measures the tsx --test unit suite only — the lib/*, view-model, and pure-derivation layers plus module contracts. It does NOT include e2e/Playwright coverage of pages/components; a low component number here is expected and fine, the battery covers behavior. The ratchet fails when any metric drops below its floor; run `npm run coverage:update` after INTENTIONALLY accepted decreases (with the PR reason) or improvements. 2026-10-17 (login-iteration batch): lines 95.21->95.15 — the FastLoginHint banner component + the register/staff form wiring land e2e-covered (contract-red until the backend half merges; the unit suite has no component harness by design), branches/functions both ROSE.
